decisions.text: #307 slice (owner): native STT only. speech_to_text pinned 7.3.0 (v1-proven with AGP 8.11.1/Kotlin 2.2.20; 7.5.0 drops the kotlin-android plugin for AGP 9 built-in Kotlin, 7.4.0 broken Android publish). Supported: Android, iOS, macOS, Web (initialize lazily on first tap, which asks permission); Linux and Windows off (v1 disabled native Windows for stability). Injected SpeechDictation in AppDependencies + Provider; ComposerFrame gets a voice widget; red ball (v1 UX) breathes slowly and swells with an adaptive level; reduced motion static. Notes draft sent for approval.

Implemented: lib/shared/voice/speech_dictation.dart (SpeechDictation + NativeSpeechDictation, lazy initialize, stop waits 3s for final words), composer_voice_button.dart (red ball, breath 1.8s, adaptive level, reduced motion still, user edit cancels, late words dropped), ComposerFrame voice slot with GlobalKey (keeps state/focus across rows; found via workspace_desktop Tab test), DI + Provider, 5 l10n keys x14, Android RECORD_AUDIO + RecognitionService query. Tests: 15 voice tests; test/v2/sessions+shared 1673 pass. BEHAVIOR, v2-plan §17, #307 comment.

Review r1 of da78fb84 (base 25b15ce5): dir /tmp/opencode/reviewb22.WEzqpn, key codewalk-307-native-voice-20261112T205031Z-e558, review id rvw_20261112T205031Z_f6d1da97, work item codewalk-307-native-voice. Eligible 8 (argon no longer listed). DeepSeek off-peak (Thu 20:50 UTC). Gate make check + v2-native-check running.

Handshakes r1 voice: READY haiku, deepseek, grok-F, minimax-F, step-5; luna and sol-F failed first (OpenCode 400 tool schema) and READY on retry; gemini-38 SESSION_GEMINI_ERROR twice: failed, excluded.

Owner approved the beta.22 notes as sent (scratchpad/beta22-notes.md). Owner steer: the mic icon colors must change when active (already: filled onError mic on the red ball; add a test asserting it after the gate/review). Owner asked whether AGENTS.md covers v1->v2 migration: yes, 'v1 is a UX reference, never a source of code'; propose a refinement (read v1 for lessons, write v2 fresh) for approval.

Owner approved the AGENTS.md rule; line added under 'v1 is a UX reference' (read v1 for lessons, write v2 fresh, never copy). Left uncommitted until the review loop is squashed, then committed on its own (docs, no gate).

Voice r1 judgment (A0001), verified in plugin source (Android error posted after notListening/doneNoResult; recognizerNotAvailable exception; web 'not supported' permanent, runtime names non-permanent; androidNoBluetooth exists). ACCEPT A draft enabled !sending + cancel on disable + sync cancel at send; B stop before listen ends at once; C recognizerNotAvailable->unavailable; D web mapping (not-allowed/service-not-allowed->denied per grok-F); E done 500 ms grace, notListening 3 s grace; F non-permanent ending error cancels recognizer; G NaN guard; H androidNoBluetooth; I unavailable tooltip only when unsupported; J stopping state; K drop composerVoiceSoon; L doc reword. REJECT M (haiku): no iOS runner ships; note in #307. Plus icon color test. Async session changes -> re-review r2.
Voice r2 (re-review: async session changes) of 25b15ce5..81c8bbf6 on the 7 sessions; gemini-38 gets one handshake attempt. Gate make check on 81c8bbf6 running.

Voice r2 judgment (A0002): ACCEPT N (a stop keeps its 3 s wait; done/notListening never shorten it), P (grace expiry cancels the recognizer if the session is still current), Q (arm grace before plugin stop; plugin stop/cancel errors swallowed), R (session ended during listen -> cancel after listen returns), S (non-permanent error cancels even after end), T (stopping tooltip 'Voice input'), U (BEHAVIOR macOS prompts). REJECT O (luna, non-frontier): Web is not shipped in v2 betas; the first tap reports unavailable and turns the mic off; probing the browser API needs a web-only import, deferred to #307's web work. No frontier rejected. Lifecycle fixes are async -> short r3.

Voice r3 (re-review, async lifecycle) of 25b15ce5..9e519c47: continuation r3.txt to the 7 sessions; gemini-38 (READY handshake after r2) gets a fresh complete payload (payload-fresh.txt, whole range). Gate make check on 9e519c47 running.

Owner decision for the queued timeline beta (follow-up): remove the top permission-mode chip; the picker footer's toggle maps to the server: off = Ask, on = Allow all; on is the default when the server reports nothing; changing it writes to the server. Check against ADR-059 during planning (may need an ADR update).

Voice r3 judgment (A0003): ACCEPT V (stop replaces any pending grace with 3 s; done arms 500 ms only when no grace pends), W (cleanup after listen also when stopRequested, keeping the newer-session guard), X minimax-F's narrower form (non-permanent error cancels only when no live session; a live session's error ends it then cancels), Y (no onWords after end), Z (_session cleared when it ends), AA (a route over the composer ends the dictation on the next result). PARTIAL REJECT X luna: the plugin does not tag errors by session, so a late non-permanent error from a finished web session landing in the next live one stays a rare residual (web not shipped). Short r4 after fixes (async).
Voice r4 (re-review of r3 lifecycle fixes) of 25b15ce5..1af097e0 on 8 sessions (gemini-38 has its contract since r3). Gate make check on 1af097e0 running.

Voice r4 judgment (A0004): ACCEPT BB per grok-F (all app routes live in one ShellRoute, so a root navigator that can pop holds a sheet, dialog or page over the composer: cancel), ACCEPT CC (comment). No rejection. Fixes are a UI check and a comment, not concurrency/security/interface/persistence: focused checks, loop converges. Gate 1af097e0 green.

next_action: Apply BB+CC, focused tests, commit, squash, gate, push, notes, beta.22
